trapFamily.trap: vendor shape in the port: the payment provider's request, response, decline codes and error class leak into the port and the checkout service

subGoals.rule: Ports and the application core speak the application's own language; the payment provider's request, response, field names and decline codes stay in the adapter (Cockburn P1: each adapter talks to the application through a port).
The core has no runtime dependency on the vendor SDK: a provider outage reaches it as its own error (Cockburn P1).

precedent: clean-shaped: the existing refund port (application/ports/out/Refunds.ts) is written in the application's own types (Money, RefundReceipt) and the Paystream refunds adapter translates to and from the SDK's request and response.
